breakthrough_tracks.title_zh: 单基因遗传缺陷与缺失蛋白的源头修复
breakthrough_tracks.subtitle_zh: 从“提心吊胆终身服药/等待突发”走向“一次修复致病根源”
breakthrough_tracks.painpoint_zh: 许多遗传病并非细胞坏了，只是基因编码少了关键一环（如 SERPINC1 缺少抗凝血酶“刹车蛋白”、SMN1 缺乏、凝血因子或酶缺陷），让患者自出生起就暴露在高危或渐进衰退中。

curated.treatability_summary_zh: 目前尚无任何经证实可延缓PSC自然病程或阻止肝硬化的特效获批药物，治疗以内镜下狭窄扩张、控制反复胆管炎感染及筛查肿瘤为主；肝移植是终末期唯一根治性手段。

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 中国属罕见胆汁淤积性肝病，缺乏全国性独立死亡统计。

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球患病率约10–15/10万（北欧与北美较高，约70%–80%患者合并溃疡性结肠炎等IBD）。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国及东亚地区患病率明显低于欧美（约1–3/10万估算，临床医院队列逐年增多，男性略多见）。

master.definition_en: A rare autosomal recessive axonal hereditary motor and sensory neuropathy characterized by motor-predominant axonal polyneuropathy due to a defect in copper metabolism. Patients become symptomatic in infancy or childhood with subtle motor delay or regression, manifesting with progressive weakness, muscle wasting, and absent reflexes in the lower and upper extremities. master.definition_en: A rare and extreme form of psoriasis characterized by the appearance of sterile pustules which can take many patterns. All the main pathological features of the disease are accentuated. Generalized pustular psoriasis is clinically heterogeneous in its age at onset, precipitants, severity, and natural history. master.definition_en: A rare multisystemic syndrome characterized by global developmental delay, postnatal microcephaly, intellectual disability, ataxia, sensorineural hearing loss, and exocrine pancreatic insufficiency. More variable manifestations include hypotonia, growth retardation, peripheral demyelinating neuropathy, dysmorphic facial features, and additional endocrine abnormalities. Brain imaging may show progressive cerebellar atrophy in some patients.

breakthrough_tracks.ai4ls_entry_zh: 时序多模态生理异常检测 + 血液高凝状态前置生物标志物发现 + 低成本家系表型筛查算法。

master.definition_en: Cerebral small vessel disease is the term currently used to pathological processes that affect the brain parenchymal circulation (arterioles, capillaries, and veins). It is a major contributor to stroke, and a leading cause of cognitive impairment and dementia.
